config.source:
SELECT
  dd.FullDate AS order_date,
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', dd.FullDate) AS order_month,
  YEAR(dd.FullDate) AS YearNumber,
  due_dd.FullDate AS due_date,
  ship_dd.FullDate AS ship_date,
  fpo.PurchaseOrderID,
  fpo.PurchaseOrderDetailID,
  fpo.OrderQty,
  fpo.ReceivedQty,
  fpo.RejectedQty,
  fpo.StockedQty,
  fpo.PurchaseAmount,
  fpo.PurchaseStatus,
  ds.SupplierKey,
  ds.SupplierName,
  ds.CreditRating,
  ds.ActiveFlag,
  ds.PreferredSupplierStatus,
  dp.ProductKey,
  dp.ProductName,
  COALESCE(dp.CategoryName, 'Uncategorized') AS category_name
FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.fact_purchase_order fpo INNER JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date dd
  ON fpo.OrderDateKey = dd.DateKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date due_dd
  ON fpo.DueDateKey = due_dd.DateKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date ship_dd
  ON fpo.ShipDateKey = ship_dd.DateKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_supplier ds
  ON fpo.SupplierKey = ds.SupplierKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_product dp
  ON fpo.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
WHERE dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
  AND YEAR(dd.FullDate) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025

dimensions.name: delivery_status
dimensions.expr: CASE WHEN ship_date > due_date THEN 'Late' WHEN ship_date IS NULL THEN 'Not Shipped' ELSE 'On Time' END

config.source:
SELECT
  start_dd.FullDate AS start_date,
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', start_dd.FullDate) AS start_month,
  YEAR(start_dd.FullDate) AS YearNumber,
  due_dd.FullDate AS due_date,
  end_dd.FullDate AS end_date,
  fp.WorkOrderID,
  fp.OrderQty,
  fp.StockedQty,
  fp.ScrappedQty,
  fp.ProductKey,
  dp.ProductName,
  COALESCE(dp.CategoryName, 'Uncategorized') AS category_name,
  CASE WHEN end_dd.FullDate <= due_dd.FullDate THEN 'On Schedule' WHEN end_dd.FullDate > due_dd.FullDate THEN 'Delayed' ELSE 'Not Completed' END AS work_order_schedule_status
FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.fact_production fp INNER JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date start_dd
  ON fp.StartDateKey = start_dd.DateKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date due_dd
  ON fp.DueDateKey = due_dd.DateKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date end_dd
  ON fp.EndDateKey = end_dd.DateKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_product dp
  ON fp.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
WHERE start_dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
  AND YEAR(start_dd.FullDate) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025

measures.name: schedule_adherence_pct
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN end_date <= due_date THEN WorkOrderID END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT WorkOrderID), 0)

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT
    YEAR(dd.FullDate) AS YearNumber,
    SUM(fs.SalesAmount) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fs.SalesOrderID) AS total_sales_orders
  FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.fact_sales fs
  INNER JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date dd
    ON fs.OrderDateKey = dd.DateKey
  WHERE dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
    AND YEAR(dd.FullDate) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
  GROUP BY YEAR(dd.FullDate)
), purchase AS (
  SELECT
    YEAR(dd.FullDate) AS YearNumber,
    SUM(fpo.PurchaseAmount) AS total_purchase_spend
  FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.fact_purchase_order fpo
  INNER JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date dd
    ON fpo.OrderDateKey = dd.DateKey
  WHERE dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
    AND YEAR(dd.FullDate) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
  GROUP BY YEAR(dd.FullDate)
), production AS (
  SELECT
    YEAR(dd.FullDate) AS YearNumber,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fp.WorkOrderID) AS total_work_orders,
    SUM(fp.OrderQty) AS total_order_qty,
    SUM(fp.StockedQty) AS total_stocked_qty,
    SUM(fp.ScrappedQty) AS total_scrapped_qty
  FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.fact_production fp
  INNER JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date dd
    ON fp.StartDateKey = dd.DateKey
  WHERE dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
    AND YEAR(dd.FullDate) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
  GROUP BY YEAR(dd.FullDate)
) SELECT
  s.YearNumber,
  s.total_revenue,
  s.total_sales_orders,
  p.total_purchase_spend,
  pr.total_work_orders,
  pr.total_stocked_qty,
  pr.total_order_qty,
  pr.total_scrapped_qty
FROM sales s INNER JOIN purchase p
  ON s.YearNumber = p.YearNumber
INNER JOIN production pr
  ON s.YearNumber = pr.YearNumber

WITH sales_by_customer AS (
  SELECT
    fs.CustomerKey,
    SUM(fs.SalesAmount) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fs.SalesOrderID) AS sales_orders
  FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.fact_sales fs
  INNER JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date dd
    ON fs.OrderDateKey = dd.DateKey
  WHERE dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
  GROUP BY fs.CustomerKey
) SELECT
  dc.CustomerKey,
  dc.AccountNumber,
  dc.CustomerType,
  COALESCE(sbc.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue,
  COALESCE(sbc.sales_orders, 0) AS sales_orders,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(sbc.sales_orders, 0) = 0 THEN 'No Orders' ELSE 'Has Orders' END AS sales_presence
FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_customer dc LEFT JOIN sales_by_customer sbc
  ON dc.CustomerKey = sbc.CustomerKey

measures.name: active_customers_with_sales_orders
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales_orders > 0 THEN CustomerKey END)

config.source:
WITH sales_by_product AS (
  SELECT
    fs.ProductKey,
    SUM(fs.SalesAmount) AS total_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fs.SalesOrderID) AS sales_orders,
    SUM(fs.OrderQty) AS units_sold
  FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.fact_sales fs
  INNER JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date dd
    ON fs.OrderDateKey = dd.DateKey
  WHERE dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
  GROUP BY fs.ProductKey
) SELECT
  dp.ProductKey,
  dp.ProductName,
  dp.ProductNumber,
  COALESCE(dp.CategoryName, 'Uncategorized') AS category_name,
  dp.SubcategoryName,
  dp.FinishedGoodsFlag,
  dp.ListPrice,
  dp.StandardCost,
  COALESCE(sbp.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue,
  COALESCE(sbp.sales_orders, 0) AS sales_orders,
  COALESCE(sbp.units_sold, 0) AS units_sold,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(sbp.sales_orders, 0) = 0 THEN 'No Sales' ELSE 'Has Sales' END AS sales_presence
FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_product dp LEFT JOIN sales_by_product sbp
  ON dp.ProductKey = sbp.ProductKey
WHERE dp.IsCurrent = true

measures.name: finished_goods_products
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN FinishedGoodsFlag THEN ProductKey END)

measures.name: low_or_no_sales_products
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sales_orders = 0 THEN ProductKey END)

WITH purchase_by_vendor AS (
  SELECT
    fpo.SupplierKey,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fpo.PurchaseOrderID) AS purchase_orders,
    SUM(fpo.PurchaseAmount) AS purchase_spend
  FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.fact_purchase_order fpo
  INNER JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date dd
    ON fpo.OrderDateKey = dd.DateKey
  WHERE dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
  GROUP BY fpo.SupplierKey
) SELECT
  ds.SupplierKey,
  ds.SupplierName,
  ds.CreditRating,
  ds.ActiveFlag,
  ds.PreferredSupplierStatus,
  COALESCE(pbv.purchase_orders, 0) AS purchase_orders,
  COALESCE(pbv.purchase_spend, 0) AS purchase_spend,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(pbv.purchase_orders, 0) = 0 THEN 'No Purchase Orders' ELSE 'Has Purchase Orders' END AS po_presence
FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_supplier ds LEFT JOIN purchase_by_vendor pbv
  ON ds.SupplierKey = pbv.SupplierKey

measures.name: active_vendors
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ActiveFlag THEN SupplierKey END)

measures.name: preferred_vendors
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PreferredSupplierStatus THEN SupplierKey END)

measures.name: vendors_without_purchase_orders
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN purchase_orders = 0 THEN SupplierKey END)

SELECT
  actual_start_dd.FullDate AS actual_start_date,
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', COALESCE(actual_start_dd.FullDate, sched_start_dd.FullDate)) AS operation_month,
  YEAR(COALESCE(actual_start_dd.FullDate, sched_start_dd.FullDate)) AS YearNumber,
  sched_end_dd.FullDate AS scheduled_end_date,
  actual_end_dd.FullDate AS actual_end_date,
  fwoo.WorkOrderID,
  fwoo.OperationSequence,
  fwoo.ProductKey,
  dp.ProductName,
  fwoo.WorkCenterKey,
  dwc.WorkCenterName,
  fwoo.ActualResourceHours,
  fwoo.PlannedCost,
  fwoo.ActualCost,
  fwoo.CostVariance,
  CASE WHEN actual_end_dd.FullDate <= sched_end_dd.FullDate THEN 'On Schedule' WHEN actual_end_dd.FullDate > sched_end_dd.FullDate THEN 'Delayed' ELSE 'Not Completed' END AS operation_schedule_status
FROM smart_factory_dev.gold.fact_work_order_operation fwoo LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date sched_start_dd
  ON fwoo.ScheduledStartDateKey = sched_start_dd.DateKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date sched_end_dd
  ON fwoo.ScheduledEndDateKey = sched_end_dd.DateKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date actual_start_dd
  ON fwoo.ActualStartDateKey = actual_start_dd.DateKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_date actual_end_dd
  ON fwoo.ActualEndDateKey = actual_end_dd.DateKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_product dp
  ON fwoo.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN smart_factory_dev.gold.dim_work_center dwc
  ON fwoo.WorkCenterKey = dwc.WorkCenterKey
WHERE COALESCE(actual_start_dd.FullDate, sched_start_dd.FullDate) BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
  AND YEAR(COALESCE(actual_start_dd.FullDate, sched_start_dd.FullDate)) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025

measures.name: schedule_adherence_pct
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN actual_end_date <= scheduled_end_date THEN CONCAT(CAST(WorkOrderID AS STRING), '-', CAST(OperationSequence AS STRING)) END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(CAST(WorkOrderID AS STRING), '-', CAST(OperationSequence AS STRING))), 0)

datasets.name: top_vendors_spend
queryLines:
WITH vendor_spend AS (
  SELECT
    ds.SupplierName,
    SUM(fpo.PurchaseAmount) AS purchase_spend
  FROM
    fact_purchase_order fpo
      INNER JOIN dim_date dd
        ON fpo.OrderDateKey = dd.DateKey
      LEFT JOIN dim_supplier ds
        ON fpo.SupplierKey = ds.SupplierKey
  WHERE
    dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
    AND YEAR(dd.FullDate) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
  GROUP BY
    ds.SupplierName
)
SELECT
  SupplierName,
  purchase_spend
FROM
  vendor_spend
WHERE
  purchase_spend > 0
ORDER BY
  purchase_spend DESC,
  SupplierName ASC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: top_customer_accounts
queryLines:
WITH customer_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    dc.AccountNumber,
    dc.CustomerType,
    SUM(fs.SalesAmount) AS total_revenue
  FROM
    fact_sales fs
      INNER JOIN dim_date dd
        ON fs.OrderDateKey = dd.DateKey
      LEFT JOIN dim_customer dc
        ON fs.CustomerKey = dc.CustomerKey
  WHERE
    dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
    AND YEAR(dd.FullDate) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
  GROUP BY
    dc.AccountNumber,
    dc.CustomerType
)
SELECT
  AccountNumber,
  CustomerType,
  total_revenue
FROM
  customer_revenue
WHERE
  total_revenue > 0
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC,
  AccountNumber ASC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: top_products_revenue
queryLines:
WITH product_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    dp.ProductName,
    COALESCE(dp.CategoryName, 'Uncategorized') AS category_name,
    SUM(fs.SalesAmount) AS total_revenue
  FROM
    fact_sales fs
      INNER JOIN dim_date dd
        ON fs.OrderDateKey = dd.DateKey
      LEFT JOIN dim_product dp
        ON fs.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
  WHERE
    dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
    AND YEAR(dd.FullDate) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
  GROUP BY
    dp.ProductName,
    COALESCE(dp.CategoryName, 'Uncategorized')
)
SELECT
  ProductName,
  category_name,
  total_revenue
FROM
  product_revenue
WHERE
  total_revenue > 0
ORDER BY
  total_revenue DESC,
  ProductName ASC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: top_products_yield
queryLines:
WITH product_yield AS (
  SELECT
    dp.ProductName,
    SUM(fp.StockedQty) / NULLIF(SUM(fp.OrderQty), 0) AS production_yield_pct,
    SUM(fp.ScrappedQty) / NULLIF(SUM(fp.OrderQty), 0) AS scrap_rate_pct,
    SUM(fp.OrderQty) AS planned_qty
  FROM
    fact_production fp
      INNER JOIN dim_date dd
        ON fp.StartDateKey = dd.DateKey
      LEFT JOIN dim_product dp
        ON fp.ProductKey = dp.ProductKey
  WHERE
    dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
    AND YEAR(dd.FullDate) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
  GROUP BY
    dp.ProductName
)
SELECT
  ProductName,
  production_yield_pct,
  scrap_rate_pct,
  planned_qty
FROM
  product_yield
WHERE
  production_yield_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  production_yield_pct DESC,
  planned_qty DESC,
  ProductName ASC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: top_vendors_rejection
queryLines:
WITH vendor_quality AS (
  SELECT
    ds.SupplierName,
    SUM(fpo.RejectedQty) / NULLIF(SUM(fpo.OrderQty), 0) AS rejection_rate_pct,
    SUM(fpo.PurchaseAmount) AS purchase_spend,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fpo.PurchaseOrderID) AS purchase_orders
  FROM
    fact_purchase_order fpo
      INNER JOIN dim_date dd
        ON fpo.OrderDateKey = dd.DateKey
      LEFT JOIN dim_supplier ds
        ON fpo.SupplierKey = ds.SupplierKey
  WHERE
    dd.FullDate BETWEEN DATE('2022-01-01') AND DATE('2025-12-31')
    AND YEAR(dd.FullDate) BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025
  GROUP BY
    ds.SupplierName
)
SELECT
  SupplierName,
  rejection_rate_pct,
  purchase_spend,
  purchase_orders
FROM
  vendor_quality
WHERE
  rejection_rate_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  rejection_rate_pct DESC,
  purchase_spend DESC,
  SupplierName ASC
LIMIT 10
